paragraphs: The 777 is how Emirates built its network, and it still carries most of it. The aircraft's proportions are deceptive: it looks conventional until parked next to something else, at which point the diameter of the fuselage becomes obvious.

The airframe holds 725,243 polygons and 743,855 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, textured with 12 maps, 6 of them at 8192x8192 and 6 at 4K. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification, and a rigged build is offered separately.
At $129 it suits flight simulation, airline and airport visualisation, travel advertising, film backgrounds and editorial illustration. On sale since 2017.
